specificationIntents.purpose:
# Feature

A person adds clients by name. A person adds projects under a client. Each project has an hourly rate in pounds and a billable flag. The project picker on [time-today](../time-today/time-today.spec.md) lists these projects grouped by client, in place of the fixed short list. When there are no projects yet, the picker offers Admin, Client work and Internal under a client called Eggs. Today's total also shows the billable amount: billable hours times each project's rate. A project can be archived, which hides it from the picker but keeps its entries.

# Intention & objectives

A person who bills by the hour organises time by client and project, so each hour carries the right rate and billable flag when they bill or report it later. Clients and projects come after [time-today](../time-today/time-today.spec.md)'s core loop, before reports and weeks.

# Feature

A page shows one egg emoji in the middle. Below it, the word 'Eggs' appears in sans-serif text.

# Intention & objectives

The page lets a visitor see an egg emoji centered on the screen. The word 'Eggs' sits under it in a plain sans-serif typeface.

# Feature

One page tracks time today. A person types what they are working on, picks a project from a short list, starts a timer and stops it. Today's entries show in a list with each duration and the day's total. A person can add an entry by hand with a duration, edit an entry, and delete one with an undo. Entries stay after a reload. The page keeps the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' from the egg page as a centered header.

# Intention & objectives

A person who bills by the hour records where their day goes while they work, so the hours are right when they bill or report them later. This first slice proves the core loop for one day: start, stop, correct and total. Projects, clients, weeks and reports come in later slices.
